full_prompt_en: A dark fashion photograph frames a woman in left-facing profile among deep red flowers and warm points of light. Her face occupies the center-right, eyes lowered and lips slightly parted, the nose and cheek cut by a soft amber beam. A black net veil crosses the forehead and cheek in an irregular lattice, while a lavish crown of crimson, rust, and burnt-orange blossoms rises above the head. Tiny metallic glints are caught among the flowers and near the hairline. A high black collar closes the lower face into shadow; a richly patterned red-and-gold shoulder curves along the right edge. More flowers blur across the bottom foreground, partially hiding the garment and creating layers between the viewer and the subject. The background remains a dark wine-red haze, with round amber bokeh lights scattered on the left. Warm light selectively reveals skin, petals, beads, and fine net threads, allowing the rest to sink into velvety black. The close crop keeps the face and floral ornament in a dense, almost theatrical arrangement. Smooth skin and soft optical blur contrast with the crisp web of the veil and the tactile clustered petals. The color range is narrow but intense, built from black, burgundy, copper, and gold. The whole frame feels intimate and opulent, as though a private moment were caught within a dimly lit stage tableau.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅深色时尚摄影作品将一位朝左侧面的女子置于深红花朵与温暖光点之间。她的面容占据中央偏右，双眼低垂，嘴唇微张，柔和琥珀光切过鼻梁与脸颊。黑色网纱以不规则格纹掠过额头和脸侧，绯红、铁锈色与焦橙色花朵组成丰盛花冠，从头顶升起。花丛与发际附近有细小金属亮点闪烁。高高的黑色衣领让下方面容隐入阴影，带红金纹样的肩部沿右侧边缘弯曲。更多花朵在下方前景失焦，部分遮住衣物，在观者与人物之间建立层次。背景保持为深葡萄酒红色薄雾，左侧散着圆润的琥珀色焦外光斑。暖光有选择地照出肌肤、花瓣、珠饰和细网线，让其他部分沉入绒面般的黑色。近距离裁切把面孔和花饰压在密集、近乎戏剧舞台式的安排中。平滑肌肤和柔软的光学模糊，与清晰的网格和可触的簇状花瓣形成对照。色彩范围狭窄却浓烈，由黑、酒红、铜色和金色构成。整幅画亲密而华丽，仿佛在昏暗舞台布景中捕捉了一瞬私密时刻。
style_prompt_en: The fashion photograph uses a narrow, saturated range of black, burgundy, copper, and amber gold. Warm directional light grazes one central plane and a few textured accents, while much of the frame sinks into velvety shadow. A close crop compresses the space into layered soft foreground blur, a sharply detailed focal area, and scattered circular bokeh farther back. Fine net-like lines, clustered organic textures, and tiny metallic highlights supply intricate detail against broad dark fields. Smooth luminous surfaces contrast with rougher matte materials and soft petals. The composition has a theatrical diagonal movement from brighter lower areas toward a dense ornamented upper edge. The background remains hazy and indistinct, preserving the impression of depth without describing a room. The whole frame feels opulent, secretive, and intimate through selective focus, low-key light, and rich warm color.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅时尚摄影作品使用黑色、酒红、铜色和琥珀金组成狭窄却饱和的色彩范围。暖色定向光掠过中央一片平面和少数有肌理的重点，画面大部分沉入绒面般阴影。近距离裁切将空间压成柔软失焦的前景、细节清楚的焦点和后方零散圆形光斑。纤细网格线、聚集的有机肌理和微小金属高光在宽阔深色区域前提供精巧细节。平滑发光的表面与较粗糙的哑光材质、柔软花瓣彼此对照。构图从较亮的下方区域斜向上部装饰密集的边缘，具有戏剧化走势。背景保持朦胧难辨，留下深度印象，却不描写具体房间。整幅画通过有选择的对焦、低调照明和浓郁暖色，显得华丽、隐秘而亲密。
theme_en: A flower-crowned figure in amber shadow
theme_zh: 琥珀色阴影中的花冠人物
name: Mert Alas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
